canonical_project: Former IBM Site, Spango Valley, Greenock data centre and BESS

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Project consultation site states Slate Island Developments is proposing a data centre at the former IBM site, Spango Valley, Greenock, alongside a co-located BESS, with a PAN submitted to Inverclyde Council. DCD reported the BESS is 99MW and data centre plans show two large buildings, but data centre MW capacity has not been shared.
